// Qualified Node.js/Deno error realm; native keeps local ReferenceError.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/Function/internals/Construct/derived-this-uninitialized-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var referenceRealm = $262.createRealm();
var C = referenceRealm.evalScript(
  '(class C extends Object {' +
  '  constructor() {}' +
  '});'
);

assert.throws(referenceRealm.global.ReferenceError, function() {
  new C();
});
})();



console.log("DS19 derived-this complete");
